name: The Arbitration Agreement
title: The Arbitration Agreement
text:
1. My client and you are parties to {{underlying_agreement_description}} dated {{underlying_agreement_date}} ("the said Agreement").
2. Clause {{arbitration_clause_number}} of the said Agreement is an arbitration agreement within the meaning of Section 7 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, and provides for the reference of disputes to arbitration seated at {{arbitration_city}}.

legal_basis.note: An arbitration agreement must be in writing and may be in a document signed by the parties or in an exchange of communications
The parties are free to agree on the place of arbitration

statutory_reference: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 - S.7, S.20
authoring_note: The arbitration agreement must be identified precisely, because the tribunal's jurisdiction comes from it and nothing else. Where the clause is in a document incorporated by reference rather than signed, the advocate should satisfy themselves that the incorporation is specific enough to carry the arbitration clause across - a general reference to another contract's terms has been held insufficient.
